overview: 本期共收录 2 篇论文。研究方向主要集中在绿色金融与可持续发展（1 篇）、银行与信贷（1 篇）。来源分布：Semantic Scholar（2 篇）。其中 1 篇命中顶级期刊白名单。

papers.title:
ESG
 , Policy Uncertainty and Green Innovation
papers.abstract: China's energy sector is central to national economic growth and industrialization, yet it faces mounting environmental challenges due to its heavy reliance on coal‐based energy. Grounded in real‐options theory and stakeholder theory, this study examines the relationship between corporate environmental, social and governance (ESG) initiatives, firm‐perceived economic policy uncertainty (FEPU) and green innovation strategy (GIS) in China's energy industry. Using a panel of 1203 Chinese A‐share‐listed energy firms from 2010 to 2023, we find that ESG initiatives significantly promote GIS, with stronger effects observed in utility‐oriented green innovations and social dimension–driven ESG activities. Moreover, FEPU positively moderates the ESG–GIS relationship, highlighting the dual role of policy uncertainty as both a constraint and a catalyst for strategic innovation. Heterogeneity analyses indicate that this relationship is more pronounced among larger firms, low‐leverage firms, state‐owned enterprises and non‐new‐energy firms. Further evidence shows stronger effects in the post‐Paris Agreement period, while FEPU's moderating role is more evident before COVID‐19. Overall, the findings offer important implications for policymakers and corporate leaders seeking to foster sustainable innovation under regulatory uncertainty.
papers.summary_zh: 【绿色金融与可持续发展】中国的能源行业对国家经济增长和工业化进程至关重要，但由于过度依赖煤炭能源，该行业正面临日益严重的环境挑战。本研究基于实物期权理论和利益相关者理论，探讨了中国能源行业中企业环境、社会与治理（ESG）实践、企业对经济政策不确定性的感知（FEPU）以及绿色创新战略（GIS）之间的关系。通过对2010年至2023年间1203家中国A股上市能源企业的数据分析，我们发现ESG实践显著促进了绿色创新战略的实施，其中以公用事业为导向的绿色创新以及由社会维度驱动的ESG活动所产生的促进作用更为显著。此外，经济政策不确定性在ESG与绿色创新战略之间的关系中起到了正向调节作用，表明政策不确定性既可能成为战略创新的制约因素，也可能成为其推动因素。异质性分析表明，这种关系在规模较大的企业、杠杆率较低的企业、国有企业以及非新能源企业中更为明显。进一步的研究发现，在《巴黎协定》签署后的时期，ESG实践对绿色创新的促进作用更为显著；而经济政策不确定性的调节作用在COVID-19疫情之前更为明显。总体而言，这些研究结果为政策制定者和企业领导者提供了重要启示，有助于他们在监管不确定性环境下推动可持续创新的发展。。

papers.title: Loyalitas Pelanggan Melalui Strategi Customer Relationship Management Pada Perbankan Syariah Indonesia
papers.venue: Journal of islamic economics and finance
papers.abstract: Customer loyalty is a strategic asset that supports the sustainability of the Islamic banking business amid increasingly intense competition, including following the merger of three state-owned Islamic banks into PT Bank Syariah Indonesia (BSI). Customer Relationship Management (CRM) is considered a key strategy for building, maintaining, and enhancing customer loyalty through systematic customer data management at the strategic, operational, and analytical levels. This study aims to map the concepts, dimensions, and mechanisms underlying the relationships among CRM, customer satisfaction, trust, and customer loyalty, as well as to analyze their relevance in the context of Indonesian Islamic banking following the merger. The study employs a descriptive-analytical method based on a systematic literature review of articles indexed by Google Scholar and screened using Publish or Perish over the 2015–2025 period, supported by thematic mapping to identify emerging clusters of research topics. The findings indicate that customer loyalty is formed through interactions among the three levels of CRM, mediated by customer satisfaction and trust, and that Continuity Marketing, One-to-One Marketing, and Partnering Programs contribute to customer retention. The study also finds that, following the merger, personal engagement and service digitalization have become important determinants of customer loyalty at BSI, while the accessibility of branch offices and ATMs remains a weakness that may potentially reduce customer loyalty if not properly managed. The novelty of this study lies in integrating the three-level CRM framework with the specific context of national Islamic banking consolidation, which has not been comprehensively examined in previous literature. These findings provide managerial implications for Islamic banks in designing CRM strategies that are more adaptive to customer needs in the digital era.
papers.summary_zh: 【银行与信贷】客户忠诚度是伊斯兰银行业在日益激烈的竞争环境中实现可持续发展的关键战略资产，这一竞争背景还包括三家国有伊斯兰银行合并为PT Bank Syariah Indonesia（BSI）的情况。客户关系管理（CRM）被视为通过系统化的客户数据管理，在战略、运营和分析层面建立、维护和提升客户忠诚度的核心策略。本研究旨在梳理CRM、客户满意度、信任与客户忠诚度之间关系的概念、维度及机制，并分析这些因素在印尼伊斯兰银行业合并后的实际意义。研究采用描述性分析方法，通过对2015至2025年间Google Scholar索引的文献进行系统梳理（并使用“Publish or Perish”标准进行筛选），同时借助主题映射技术识别出新兴的研究热点。研究结果表明，客户忠诚度的形成依赖于CRM三个层面的相互作用，其中客户满意度和信任起到了中介作用；持续性营销、一对一营销及合作伙伴计划对客户留存具有积极影响。此外，合并后，个性化服务与服务的数字化已成为BSI客户忠诚度的重要决定因素，而分支机构及自动取款机的便利性仍是一个潜在的薄弱环节，若管理不善可能会降低客户忠诚度。本研究的新颖之处在于将三层CRM框架与国...。
